author: smuzaffar
body:
While testing CMSSW using GCC15, we get build error [a]. Looks like `clust.originalId()` return `unsigned int` and checking its value for `>=0` is always true. This PR suggests to remove the assert.

[a] https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/jenkins-artifacts/pull-request-integration/PR-02a350/55832/build-logs/RecoLocalTracker/SiPixelRecHits/log.html
```
src/RecoLocalTracker/SiPixelRecHits/plugins/SiPixelRecHitFromSoAAlpaka.cc: In member function 'virtual void SiPixelRecHitFromSoAAlpaka::produce(edm::StreamID, edm::Event&, const edm::EventSetup&) const':
  [src/RecoLocalTracker/SiPixelRecHits/plugins/SiPixelRecHitFromSoAAlpaka.cc:141](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-11-2300/RecoLocalTracker/SiPixelRecHits/plugins/SiPixelRecHitFromSoAAlpaka.cc#L141):7: error: comparison is always true due to limited range of data type [-Werror=type-limits]
   141 |       assert(clust.originalId() >= 0);
```
title: SiPixelRecHit: Fix assert on unsigned>=0
